# Straum

> In-memory PostgreSQL aggregates, kept current as PostgreSQL commits.

Straum is not stable yet. The spec, the asks and the flags may change.

Pages other than the quick start, the command line and performance
use the `usage` view over `public.events AS e` and
`public.accounts AS a`. Those three use the January 2024 taxi trips.

## Summary

- [Straum](https://janbjorge.github.io/straum/index.html): Why Straum:
  the problem, the usage view, one ask, and what Straum is not.
  Examples use the usage view.
- [Quick start](https://janbjorge.github.io/straum/quick-start.html):
  Does it work: the one tutorial, on the taxi trips. Examples use the
  taxi trips.
- [Try it on your data](https://janbjorge.github.io/straum/your-data.html):
  Does it answer my queries: a copy of your tables from pg_dump, in
  Docker, with Straum on it. Examples use the usage view.

## Concepts

- [How Straum works](https://janbjorge.github.io/straum/how-it-works.html):
  How it works: load, follow, cells, dims, the physical stream,
  `as_of` and its consistency. Examples use the usage view.
- [Aggregates 101](https://janbjorge.github.io/straum/aggregates.html):
  What a measure costs: merging, deletes, and what a cell keeps.
  Examples use the usage view.

## Running Straum

- [Setting up PostgreSQL](https://janbjorge.github.io/straum/postgresql.html):
  Connecting a database: logical and physical setup, the start checks,
  and what Straum costs the server. Examples use the usage view.
- [Deploying Straum](https://janbjorge.github.io/straum/deploy.html):
  Running it for real: the binary, the image and the chart. Examples
  use the usage view.
- [Performance](https://janbjorge.github.io/straum/performance.html):
  What to expect: the benchmark and memory sizing. Examples use the
  taxi trips.

## Reference

- [Spec](https://janbjorge.github.io/straum/spec.html): Every spec rule,
  and the errors `straum plan` prints. Examples use the usage view.
- [Asks and endpoints](https://janbjorge.github.io/straum/asks.html):
  The ask language, answers, errors, `Straum-LSN` and every endpoint.
  Examples use the usage view.
- [Command line](https://janbjorge.github.io/straum/cli.html): Every
  command and flag. Examples use the taxi trips.
- [Glossary](https://janbjorge.github.io/straum/glossary.html): One line
  per term, and a link to its home. Examples use the usage view.

## Contributing

- [Design](https://janbjorge.github.io/straum/design.html): Crates, the
  store, invariants and state machines, and which record shaped what.
  Examples use the usage view.
- [Reading the code](https://janbjorge.github.io/straum/reading-the-code.html):
  The order to read the crates in, and the Rust they use. Examples use
  the usage view.
